body:
### Summary

# Bug Description
I've been looking through the Pypi corpus of wheels to see what fun non-conformance there is in the files, compared to what uv auto-fixes up via its LenientRequirements validator.

Specifically, there's a regex which converts `>=1.9.*` to `>=1.9`

However, that regex does not allow whitespace betwen the equality operator and the version.
So, for example `>= 1.9.x` is not fixed up. My analysis found many unique METADATA files that have this pattern in PyPI:

Here are some counts:
```
count	value
117	>= 3.5.*
19	>= 3.7.*
16	>= 3.3.*
15	>= 3.8.*
4	>= 3.6.*
3	>= 2.6.*
2	>= 3.0.*
1	>= 3.6.*, <3.8.*
1	>= 3.7.*, <3.9.*
```

and a random example wheel that has this is
Name: fastobo
Version: 0.1.0.dev51

which contains: `Requires-Python: >= 3.5.*` (note the whitespace)

# Relevant source code
https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/blob/main/crates/uv-pypi-types/src/lenient_requirement.rs#L29
```rs
// Given `>=1.9.*`, rewrite to `>=1.9`.
    (
        |input| regex!(r"(<=|>=|<|>)(\d+(\.\d+)*)\.\*").replace_all(input, r"${1}${2}"),
        "removing star after comparison operator other than equal and not equal",
    ),
```
# Proposed soluton
Just add a `\s*` like so:
`|input| regex!(r"(<=|>=|<|>)\s*(\d+(\.\d+)*)\.\*").replace_all(input, r"${1}${2}")`
# Prior issues:
The only somewhat relevant one I could find was https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/8326


### Platform

Darwin 25.5.0 arm64

### Version

uv 0.12.1 (Homebrew 2026-07-31 aarch64-apple-darwin)

### Python version

python 3.13.13
title: LenientRequirements should allow whitespace after the star operator
